subject: Laptop very slow since Monday's Windows update
content:
My Dell XPS 15 (asset CORP-9203) has been extremely slow since the cumulative Windows update applied on Monday morning. Boot time has gone from about 35 seconds to nearly 5 minutes. Task Manager consistently shows 'Antimalware Service Executable' consuming 85-95% CPU for extended periods after login.

I have tried restarting twice and running a manual scan. No threats found. Other people on my floor say their machines are fine.

Is this a known issue with the Monday update? Can IT push a fix or exclude the scan on startup?

Tom Barnes, Engineering
